content: I would like to share with the community a project I've been working on, which pushes the formalization of physics in Lean 4 toward loop quantum gravity and high-energy theoretical physics. We have completed the formalization of several sectors of Loop Quantum Gravity (LQG), Loop Quantum Cosmology (LQC), and black hole thermodynamics.
That's great! I'd be very interested in looking at the output

Hi Fabio! Thanks for the interest. To give you an idea of the core implementation, here is a comprehensive update on the formalization status in Lean 4: the framework integrates LQG kinematics (area/volume spectra), dynamics (closure of the Dirac algebra and Master operator), spin foam models (Regge asymptotics), and GFT with condensates for the Big Bounce. On the holographic and thermodynamic front, we have closed the consistency for the Page curve, quantum islands, and the HKLL/MERA map with 0-sorry verifications.
